item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 25
item.description:
124 development commits

Buffs & UI

  • Rich beef pie now provides +25% hunger and hydration, rounded to whole numbers.
  • Buff tooltips now correctly display durations longer than 60 minutes.

AI, Animals & NPCs

  • Tin can alarm can now detect Generation 2 AIs and critters.
  • Livestock AI fixes: animals no longer go underwater, bulls no longer get stuck or attempt unreachable headbutts, curious cows won’t starve, bull damage reduced, livestock leads now slow the player and break around 7 m, and cows correctly transition after grazing.
  • Added ally status to crabs, stags, boars, and bulls so they no longer attack each other.
  • Wool vendor always offers a dialogue option to ask about wool, regardless of inventory.

Combat & Weapons

  • Melee weapons stay welded to the hand while running.
  • Minigun ammo count now updates when reloading inside a box and the reload option is hidden when ammo is full.
  • Crossbow arrows now have correct head rotation, ensuring proper flight orientation.

Resources & Crafting

  • Powergrid loot now respawns after being collected.
  • Milky and creamy teas are no longer recyclable, and spoiled produce now behaves correctly in recipes and processing.
  • Grenades spawn in the correct position when deploying the last grenade in a stack in first‑person view, and explosion overlays now have a minimum intensity threshold to prevent lingering visual effects.

Structures & Tech

  • Animal Fence and Biofuel Generator are restored in Primitive mode, scrap cost of fences and gates reduced, and both structures added to Tier‑1 tech trees; Biofuel Generator also added to Hardcore and Primitive tech trees.
  • Player rotation is corrected when dismounting, preventing a tilted orientation.

Livestock & Animals

  • Calves purchased at the ranch now display the correct gender‑specific names.
  • Lamb fleece now appears correctly at all LOD levels, ensuring wool can be harvested visually.
  • Bull item name and description have been corrected in its prefab.

Vehicles

  • Modular car builds now save reliably without thread‑related errors.

Combat

  • Melee combat animations have been fixed, improving hit detection and visual feedback.
  • Missing animation files for the M92 pistol have been restored, fixing animation issues.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 24
item.description:
73 development commits

Audio & Aiming

  • Fixed a bug where scheduled sounds could keep playing past their start time, preventing endless audio buildup.
  • Aiming accuracy is restored when using turn‑in‑place, fixing misaligned aim.

World & Environment

  • Footstep splash effects now respect lowered water levels, preventing splashes from appearing at the original surface height.
  • Critters (e.g., crabs) no longer push or move players because they are excluded from player collision layers, and LOD issues for crabs are fixed.

Inventory & Looting

  • Added an option to automatically close the entire inventory when you move away from a loot container, instead of switching to quick‑craft mode.

Combat & Weapons

  • Beancan throws now have correct trajectory visual, and molotovs display gib effects on hit and now correctly break with client‑side prediction, spawning fireballs after breaking.

Economy & Vendors

  • Vendor auction rounding for HQM ore is corrected, fixing inaccurate price calculations.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Thrown weapons (e.g., grenades, molotovs) now predict trajectories more accurately, reducing mis‑throws.
